title: ICS run record
description: One run of the Intercept Characterization System (ICS): the protobuf JSON form of ics.v1.RunRecord (proto/ics/v1/run_record.proto), printed with proto field names and every field without presence. Measurements are keyed to the JIATF 401 Common Criteria for CUAS Characterization (C4) or to a validation criterion. See schemas/README.md (ICS-013).

run_id.description: The run, unique across all test events.

event_id.description: The test event the run belongs to, for example "V2".

start_utc_ns.description: When the run started, UTC, in nanoseconds since the Unix epoch.

end_utc_ns.description: When the run ended, UTC, in nanoseconds since the Unix epoch.

range_origin.description: The origin of the range ENU frame: the defended asset.

software_revision.description: The ICS source revision that produced the record, as a full git commit SHA (SHA-1 or SHA-256).

parameter_files.description: The parameter files loaded at startup: pointing models, drag tables, kill thresholds and the like.

models.description: The models loaded at startup, such as ONNX files.

artifacts.description: Every other artifact of the run: tracks, fragments, frame metadata, PLI logs and imagery.

measurements.description: The measured values, each keyed to a C4 measure or a validation criterion.

flags.description: Conditions that limit what the run can support.

utc_ns.description: A time, UTC, in nanoseconds since the Unix epoch: an int64 written as a decimal string, as protobuf JSON writes 64-bit integers.

geodetic_point.description: A point on or above the WGS84 ellipsoid.

latitude_deg.description: Geodetic latitude, in degrees, positive north.

height_ellipsoid_m.description: Height above the WGS84 ellipsoid, in metres.

enu_vector.description: A vector in the range ENU frame; the field that holds it names the unit.

file_digest.description: A file named by its SHA-256 digest.

path.description: Path relative to the run's data root, with forward slashes.

sha256_hex.description: SHA-256 of the file's bytes, as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

size_bytes.description: Size of the file, in bytes: a uint64 written as a decimal string.

media_type.description: The file's media type, for example "application/x-protobuf".

threshold.description: One threshold the kill classifier applied, as named in the kill-threshold parameter file.

unit.description: A UCUM unit code; "1" if dimensionless.

override.description: An evaluator's override of the kill class.

reason.description: Why, in the evaluator's words; required.

kill_assessment.description: What the engagement did to its target, and the evidence for it (ics.v1.KillAssessment).

computed_class.description: The class the classifier computed. Only an evaluator assigns KILL_CLASS_NO_TEST.

contact_utc_ns.description: The time of first contact; absent if they did not touch.

miss_distance_m.description: Miss distance at closest approach, in metres.

miss_distance_sigma_m.description: One-sigma uncertainty of miss_distance_m, in metres.

intercept_point_enu_m.description: Where closest approach happened, in the range ENU frame, in metres.

ballistic_fit_residual.description: Normalized residual of the ballistic fit; absent if no fit was possible.

overrides.description: The evaluators' overrides, oldest first. The last one is in force.

polygon.description: A polygon on the ground: vertices in order, counterclockwise seen from above, not closed.

region.description: The area a piece lands in with a given probability.

footprint.description: Probability regions on the ground for the run's debris (ics.v1.Footprint).

measurement.description: One measured value. Exactly one branch applies: a C4 measure with its fixed unit, or a validation criterion.

c4_3_1_2.title: C4 MOP 3.1.2 Probability of Kill / Defeat (Pk)
c4_3_1_2.description: Per run: 1 if the kill class in force is a kill (mission, hard or catastrophic), 0 if it is no kill. Omitted for no-test and undetermined runs. C4 reports Pk in percent over runs.

c4_3_1_3.title: C4 MOP 3.1.3 Defeat Range
c4_3_1_3.description: Per defeat: the distance from the interceptor's launch point to the intercept point, in metres. C4 reports the mean over defeats in kilometres.

c4_3_1_4.title: C4 MOP 3.1.4 Defeat Engagement Time
c4_3_1_4.description: Per defeat: the time from the engage command (the trigger controller arming) to closest approach, in seconds. C4 reports the mean over defeats in seconds.

c4_int_1.title: C4 INT-1 Interceptor Max Speed
c4_int_1.description: Per run: the highest interceptor speed observed, in metres per second. C4 reports it in m/s or knots.

c4_int_2.title: C4 INT-2 Acceleration / G-Load
c4_int_2.description: Per run: the peak interceptor acceleration observed, in metres per second squared. C4 reports it in g (9.80665 m/s2).

c4_int_6.title: C4 INT-6 Terminal Guidance Accuracy (CEP)
c4_int_6.description: Per run: the miss distance at closest approach, in metres (kill_assessment.miss_distance_m). C4 reports the circular error probable over runs in metres.

validation_criterion.title: Validation criterion C1 to C19
validation_criterion.description: A value toward one of the ICS validation criteria, in the unit its definition gives as a UCUM code.
